intended_object: The truncation map x ↦ max(x, 0) from ℝ to ℝ≥0 (`Real.toNNReal`), bundled as a continuous map in C(ℝ, ℝ≥0). Inferred from the docstring.
explanation: The definition is `ContinuousMap.mk Real.toNNReal continuous_real_toNNReal`. Its underlying function is `Real.toNNReal`, which sends x to max x 0, and the continuity proof is the standard lemma, so it is exactly the docstring's "`Real.toNNReal` bundled as a continuous map". The object is specific: its codomain ℝ≥0 is part of its content, so restricting to ℝ does not make it too narrow. As far as I know, Mathlib has no other bundled version of this map.
